records.literal_gloss: Oracle. [The] word of Yahweh concerning Israel. Declaration of Yahweh, stretching out [the] heavens, and founding [the] earth, and forming [the] spirit of humankind within him:

en.L: An oracle. The word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} concerning Israel. Declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, who stretches out [the] heavens and founds [the] earth and forms the spirit of {{gender:a person|man}} within {{gender:them|him}}:
en.B: An oracle. The word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} concerning Israel. This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} declares, who stretches out the heavens, lays the foundations of the earth and forms the human spirit within each person:
en.R: This is a message from {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} about Israel. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} stretched out the sky and laid the foundations of the earth. He gives each person a spirit within them. This is what {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} says:

es.L: Oráculo. Palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} acerca de Israel. Declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, que extiende [los] cielos y funda [la] tierra y forma el espíritu del {{gender:ser humano|hombre}} dentro de él:
es.B: Oráculo. Palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} acerca de Israel. Esto afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, que extiende los cielos, pone los cimientos de la tierra y forma el espíritu humano dentro de cada persona:
es.R: Este es un mensaje {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} acerca de Israel. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} extendió el cielo y puso los cimientos de la tierra. Él da a cada persona un espíritu dentro de sí. Esto es lo que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} dice:

fr.L: Oracle. Parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} concernant Israël. Déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, qui déploie [les] cieux et fonde [la] terre et forme l’esprit de {{gender:l’être humain|l’homme}} au-dedans de lui :
fr.B: Oracle. Parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} concernant Israël. Voici ce que déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, qui déploie les cieux, pose les fondations de la terre et forme l’esprit humain au-dedans de chacun :
fr.R: Voici un message {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} au sujet d’Israël. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a déployé le ciel et posé les fondations de la terre. Il donne à chacun un esprit au-dedans de lui. Voici ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} dit :

sw.L: Unabii. Neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} juu ya Israeli. Asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, azitandaye mbingu na kuiweka misingi ya dunia na kuiumba roho ya mwanadamu ndani yake:
sw.B: Unabii. Neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kuhusu Israeli. Hivi ndivyo asemavyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, anayezitandaza mbingu, anayeiweka misingi ya dunia na kuiumba roho ya binadamu ndani ya kila mtu:
sw.R: Huu ni ujumbe kutoka kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kuhusu Israeli. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alizitandaza mbingu na kuiweka misingi ya dunia. Yeye humpa kila mtu roho ndani yake. Hili ndilo analosema:

vi.L: Sấm ngôn. Lời của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} về Y-sơ-ra-ên. {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán, là Đấng giăng [các] tầng trời ra, lập nền trái đất, và tạo nên tâm linh của con người ở bên trong người:
vi.B: Sấm ngôn. Lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} về Y-sơ-ra-ên. Đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán, là Đấng giăng các tầng trời, lập nền trái đất và tạo nên tâm linh bên trong mỗi người:
vi.R: Đây là sứ điệp của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} về Y-sơ-ra-ên. {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã giăng bầu trời ra và đặt nền trái đất. Ngài ban cho mỗi người một tâm linh ở bên trong. Đây là điều {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} phán:

ko.L: 신탁. 이스라엘에 관한 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀이다. 하늘을 펴시고 땅의 기초를 놓으시고 사람 속에 그 영을 지으신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다.
ko.B: 신탁. 이스라엘에 관한 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀. 하늘을 펴시고, 땅의 기초를 놓으시고, 사람 속에 영을 지으신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 선언하신다.
ko.R: 이것은 이스라엘에 관한 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀이다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 하늘을 펴시고 땅의 기초를 놓으셨다. 그분께서 사람마다 그 속에 영을 주신다. 그분께서 이렇게 말씀하신다.

decisions.choice: oracle ... concerning Israel: the heading of the last part of the book (chapters 12-14)
decisions.reason: The heading repeats 9:1 and begins the second of the two oracles that close the book. Chapters 12-14 speak of a final attack of the nations on Jerusalem, the LORD's rescue of the city, the cleansing of his people and his reign over all the earth. The phrase "on that day" comes again and again. The oracle is about Judah and Jerusalem, but it is headed "concerning Israel": Israel is the name of the whole people of God.

decisions.choice: who stretches out the heavens, founds the earth, forms the human spirit: the Creator speaks
decisions.reason: The LORD who speaks is named by what he has made, as in Isaiah 42:5, 44:24 and 51:13, and Psalm 104:2-5. The one who made heaven and earth and gives every human being life can do what this oracle promises. "Spirit" is the breath of life and the inner self (Genesis 2:7; Isaiah 57:16).

decisions.choice: declares the LORD: here at the start of the oracle
decisions.reason: The formula usually comes in the middle or at the end of a saying. Here it stands at the head of the oracle, joined to the titles of the Creator, as in Numbers 24:3-4 and Psalm 110:1, where the same word introduces a solemn saying.

decisions.choice: An oracle (L, B); a message (R); declares the LORD (L, B); This is what he says (R); the spirit of a person within them (L, gender setting)
decisions.reason: The heading follows 9:1. Readable breaks the Creator's titles into short sentences. The Hebrew "humankind" means men and women, so Literal takes the gender setting; Balanced says "the human spirit within each person", which needs none.

decisions.choice: "del {{gender:ser humano|hombre}}" (L)
decisions.reason: Spanish has two wordings for "humankind" here, so Literal takes the gender span on the noun, as the English does; "dentro de él" agrees with both options and needs none.

decisions.choice: "de {{gender:l’être humain|l’homme}}" (L); "au-dedans de lui" with no span
decisions.reason: The span goes on the noun French must choose; "lui" agrees with both options and takes none (style guide section 7).

decisions.choice: "mwanadamu", with no gender span
decisions.reason: "Mwanadamu" already includes men and women, so Swahili needs no gender setting where the English has one. The heading "Unabii" / "ujumbe" is worded as 9:1.

decisions.choice: "tâm linh" for the human spirit
decisions.reason: "Tâm linh" is the human spirit, kept apart from "Thần Linh", God's Spirit; "con người" needs no gender span. The heading is worded as 9:1.

decisions.choice: "신탁" (L, B); "...에 관한 말씀" (R); the Creator's titles with -시-
decisions.reason: The heading follows the terms note's *massa*. The heading is the prophet's, so the LORD named by his works takes the honorific; within the oracle that follows, God speaks without it.

source.text: הִנֵּ֣ה אָ֠נֹכִי שָׂ֣ם אֶת־יְרוּשָׁלִַ֧ם סַף־רַ֛עַל לְכָל־הָעַמִּ֖ים סָבִ֑יב וְגַ֧ם עַל־יְהוּדָ֛ה יִֽהְיֶ֥ה בַמָּצ֖וֹר עַל־יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Look, I [am] making Jerusalem a cup of reeling for all the peoples around; and also on Judah it will be in the siege on Jerusalem.

en.L: Look, I am making Jerusalem a cup of reeling for all the peoples around; and Judah also will be in the siege against Jerusalem.
en.B: Look, I am about to make Jerusalem a cup that sends all the surrounding peoples reeling. Judah too will be caught up in the siege against Jerusalem.
en.R: I am going to make Jerusalem like a cup of strong wine that makes all the nations around it stagger like drunk people. When enemies surround Jerusalem and attack it, Judah will be attacked too.

es.L: He aquí, yo pongo a Jerusalén [como] copa de vértigo para todos los pueblos de alrededor; y también Judá estará en el asedio contra Jerusalén.
es.B: {{plural_you:Miren|Mirad}}, voy a hacer de Jerusalén una copa que hará tambalearse a todos los pueblos de alrededor. También Judá se verá envuelta en el asedio contra Jerusalén.
es.R: Voy a hacer que Jerusalén sea como una copa de vino fuerte que hace tambalearse como borrachos a todas las naciones de alrededor. Cuando los enemigos rodeen Jerusalén y la ataquen, también Judá será atacada.

fr.L: Voici, je fais de Jérusalem une coupe d’étourdissement pour tous les peuples d’alentour ; et Juda aussi sera dans le siège contre Jérusalem.
fr.B: Voici que je vais faire de Jérusalem une coupe qui fera chanceler tous les peuples d’alentour. Juda aussi sera pris dans le siège contre Jérusalem.
fr.R: Je vais faire de Jérusalem comme une coupe de vin fort qui fera tituber comme des ivrognes toutes les nations autour d’elle. Quand les ennemis entoureront Jérusalem pour l’attaquer, Juda sera attaqué lui aussi.

sw.L: Tazama, {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} ninaufanya Yerusalemu kuwa kikombe cha kuyumbisha kwa mataifa yote yanayozunguka; na Yuda pia atakuwa katika kuzingirwa kwa Yerusalemu.
sw.B: Tazama, ninakaribia kuufanya Yerusalemu kuwa kikombe kinachoyafanya mataifa yote yanayouzunguka kuyumbayumba. Yuda naye atakumbwa katika kuzingirwa kwa Yerusalemu.
sw.R: Nitaufanya Yerusalemu kuwa kama kikombe cha divai kali kinachoyafanya mataifa yote yanayouzunguka kupepesuka kama walevi. Adui watakapouzingira Yerusalemu na kuushambulia, Yuda naye atashambuliwa.

vi.L: Kìa, chính {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} làm cho Giê-ru-sa-lem thành chén làm choáng váng cho mọi dân chung quanh; và Giu-đa cũng sẽ ở trong cuộc vây hãm Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.B: Kìa, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sắp làm cho Giê-ru-sa-lem thành một chén khiến mọi dân chung quanh phải lảo đảo. Giu-đa cũng sẽ bị cuốn vào cuộc vây hãm Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.R: Ta sẽ làm cho Giê-ru-sa-lem như một chén rượu mạnh khiến mọi nước chung quanh say sưa lảo đảo. Khi kẻ thù vây quanh và tấn công Giê-ru-sa-lem, Giu-đa cũng sẽ bị tấn công.

ko.L: 보아라, 내가 예루살렘을 사방 모든 민족에게 비틀거리게 하는 잔으로 만들겠다. 예루살렘이 포위될 때에 유다도 그 포위 가운데 있을 것이다.
ko.B: 보아라, 내가 예루살렘을 주위의 모든 민족을 비틀거리게 하는 잔으로 만들겠다. 예루살렘이 포위당할 때 유다도 함께 포위당할 것이다.
ko.R: 내가 예루살렘을 독한 포도주가 담긴 잔처럼 만들겠다. 주위의 모든 민족이 그것을 마시고 술 취한 사람처럼 비틀거릴 것이다. 원수들이 예루살렘을 에워싸고 공격할 때에 유다도 공격을 받을 것이다.

decisions.choice: a cup of reeling: the cup of God's anger that makes the nations stagger
decisions.reason: The prophets picture God's judgment as a cup of strong wine that those who drink it cannot keep from drinking, and that leaves them staggering (Isaiah 51:17, 22; Jeremiah 25:15-28; Psalm 75:9). The nations who come to drink, that is, to take Jerusalem, will be made drunk and helpless by it.

decisions.choice: Judah also will be in the siege: Judah shares Jerusalem's danger
alternatives: Judah will be made to take part in the siege of Jerusalem
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is brief: "and also on Judah it will be in the siege on Jerusalem". It is read here as saying that the towns of Judah will also be under attack when Jerusalem is besieged. Some read it as saying that Judah will be forced to join the siege against Jerusalem. Verses 5-7 show Judah and Jerusalem on the same side.

decisions.choice: like a cup of strong wine ... stagger like drunk people; When enemies surround Jerusalem and attack it (R)
decisions.reason: Readable explains the cup (m1) and the siege.

source.text: וְהָיָ֣ה בַיּוֹם־הַ֠הוּא אָשִׂ֨ים אֶת־יְרוּשָׁלִַ֜ם אֶ֤בֶן מַֽעֲמָסָה֙ לְכָל־הָ֣עַמִּ֔ים כָּל־עֹמְסֶ֖יהָ שָׂר֣וֹט יִשָּׂרֵ֑טוּ וְנֶאֶסְפ֣וּ עָלֶ֔יהָ כֹּ֖ל גּוֹיֵ֥י הָאָֽרֶץ׃

records.literal_gloss: And it will be on that day [that] I will make Jerusalem a stone of burden for all the peoples; all who lift it will surely injure themselves, and will be gathered against it all [the] nations of the earth.

en.L: And it will be in that day [that] I will set Jerusalem [as] a stone of burden for all the peoples; all who carry it will surely gash themselves; and all the nations of the earth will be gathered against it.
en.B: On that day I will make Jerusalem a heavy stone for all the peoples; everyone who tries to lift it will be badly hurt. And all the nations of the earth will gather against it.
en.R: At that time I will make Jerusalem like a heavy stone for all the nations. Everyone who tries to lift it will be badly hurt. All the nations of the earth will come together to attack it.

es.L: Y sucederá en aquel día [que] pondré a Jerusalén [como] piedra pesada para todos los pueblos; todos los que la carguen se herirán gravemente; y se reunirán contra ella todas las naciones de la tierra.
es.B: Aquel día haré de Jerusalén una piedra pesada para todos los pueblos; todo el que intente levantarla saldrá gravemente herido. Y todas las naciones de la tierra se reunirán contra ella.
es.R: En ese tiempo haré que Jerusalén sea como una piedra pesada para todas las naciones. Todo el que intente levantarla saldrá muy lastimado. Todas las naciones de la tierra se juntarán para atacarla.

fr.L: Et il arrivera en ce jour-là [que] je ferai de Jérusalem une pierre de fardeau pour tous les peuples ; tous ceux qui la porteront s’entailleront gravement ; et toutes les nations de la terre se rassembleront contre elle.
fr.B: Ce jour-là, je ferai de Jérusalem une pierre pesante pour tous les peuples ; tous ceux qui essaieront de la soulever se blesseront gravement. Et toutes les nations de la terre se rassembleront contre elle.
fr.R: En ce temps-là, je ferai de Jérusalem comme une pierre lourde pour toutes les nations. Tous ceux qui essaieront de la soulever se feront très mal. Toutes les nations de la terre se rassembleront pour l’attaquer.

sw.L: Na itakuwa katika siku ile, nitaufanya Yerusalemu [kuwa] jiwe la mzigo kwa mataifa yote; wote wanaolibeba watajikata vibaya sana; na mataifa yote ya dunia yatakusanyika juu yake.
sw.B: Siku hiyo nitaufanya Yerusalemu kuwa jiwe zito kwa mataifa yote; kila anayejaribu kuliinua ataumia vibaya. Na mataifa yote ya dunia yatakusanyika dhidi yake.
sw.R: Wakati huo nitaufanya Yerusalemu kuwa kama jiwe zito kwa mataifa yote. Kila atakayejaribu kuliinua ataumia vibaya. Mataifa yote ya dunia yatakusanyika kuushambulia.

vi.L: Sẽ xảy ra trong ngày ấy, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đặt Giê-ru-sa-lem [làm] hòn đá nặng cho mọi dân; hết thảy những ai khiêng nó sẽ bị trầy xước nặng nề; và mọi nước trên đất sẽ tụ họp lại nghịch cùng nó.
vi.B: Vào ngày ấy, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm cho Giê-ru-sa-lem thành một hòn đá nặng cho mọi dân; ai cố nhấc nó lên sẽ bị thương nặng. Và mọi nước trên đất sẽ tụ họp lại chống nghịch nó.
vi.R: Vào lúc ấy, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm cho Giê-ru-sa-lem như một hòn đá nặng đối với mọi nước. Ai cố nhấc nó lên sẽ bị thương nặng. Mọi nước trên đất sẽ tụ họp lại để tấn công nó.

ko.L: 그날에 이렇게 될 것이다. 내가 예루살렘을 모든 민족에게 무거운 짐 돌로 삼을 것이다. 그것을 드는 자는 모두 크게 상처를 입을 것이다. 땅의 모든 나라가 그것을 치려고 모일 것이다.
ko.B: 그날에 내가 예루살렘을 모든 민족에게 무거운 돌이 되게 하겠다. 그것을 들어 올리려는 자는 모두 크게 다칠 것이다. 땅의 모든 나라가 예루살렘을 치려고 모일 것이다.
ko.R: 그때에 내가 예루살렘을 모든 민족에게 무거운 돌처럼 만들겠다. 그것을 들어 올리려는 사람은 누구나 크게 다칠 것이다. 땅의 모든 나라가 모여서 예루살렘을 공격할 것이다.

decisions.choice: a heavy stone: a stone too heavy to lift without injury
decisions.reason: The phrase means "a stone of burden", a stone to be lifted and carried. Jerome, writing in the land of Israel in the fourth century AD, says that young men there tested their strength by lifting heavy round stones. The nations who try to carry Jerusalem off will find it too heavy and will hurt themselves.

decisions.choice: will surely gash themselves: be cut and badly hurt
decisions.reason: The verb means to cut or scratch (Leviticus 21:5), and the doubled form makes it strong. Lifting the stone tears the lifter's own flesh.

decisions.choice: And it will be in that day [that] (L); On that day (B); At that time (R)
decisions.reason: The phrase follows the wording set in Isaiah. Literal keeps the Hebrew "and it will be", as in Joel 4:18.

decisions.choice: "en ce jour-là" (L); "ce jour-là" (B); "en ce temps-là" (R)
decisions.reason: The prophetic "in that day" of chapters 12-14 keeps the terms note's wording at each level.

decisions.choice: "katika siku ile" (L); "siku hiyo" (B); "wakati huo" (R)
decisions.reason: The prophetic "in that day" of chapters 12-14 keeps the wording of Isaiah at each level.

decisions.choice: "trong ngày ấy" (L); "vào ngày ấy" (B); "vào lúc ấy" (R)
decisions.reason: The prophetic "in that day" of chapters 12-14 keeps the wording of Isaiah at each level.

decisions.choice: "그날에" (L, B); "그때에" (R)
decisions.reason: The prophetic "in that day" of chapters 12-14 keeps the wording of Isaiah at each level.

source.text: בַּיּ֨וֹם הַה֜וּא נְאֻם־יְהוָ֗ה אַכֶּ֤ה כָל־סוּס֙ בַּתִּמָּה֔וֹן וְרֹכְב֖וֹ בַּשִּׁגָּע֑וֹן וְעַל־בֵּ֤ית יְהוּדָה֙ אֶפְקַ֣ח אֶת־עֵינַ֔י וְכֹל֙ ס֣וּס הָֽעַמִּ֔ים אַכֶּ֖ה בַּֽעִוָּרֽוֹן׃

records.literal_gloss: On that day, declaration of Yahweh, I will strike every horse with panic and its rider with madness; and on [the] house of Judah I will open my eyes, and every horse of the peoples I will strike with blindness.

en.L: In that day, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, I will strike every horse with bewilderment and its rider with madness; but over the house of Judah I will open {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} eyes, and every horse of the peoples I will strike with blindness.
en.B: On that day, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, I will strike all the horses with terror and their riders with madness. I will keep {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} eyes open over the house of Judah, but I will strike the horses of the peoples with blindness.
en.R: At that time, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, I will make every horse panic and make its rider go mad. I will watch over the people of Judah, but I will make all the horses of the enemy armies blind.

es.L: En aquel día, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, heriré a todo caballo con desconcierto y a su jinete con locura; pero sobre la casa de Judá abriré {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} ojos, y a todo caballo de los pueblos heriré con ceguera.
es.B: Aquel día, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, heriré a todos los caballos con espanto y a sus jinetes con locura. Mantendré {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} ojos abiertos sobre la casa de Judá, pero heriré con ceguera a los caballos de los pueblos.
es.R: En ese tiempo, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, haré que todos los caballos se espanten y que sus jinetes se vuelvan locos. Cuidaré al pueblo de Judá, pero dejaré ciegos a todos los caballos de los ejércitos enemigos.

fr.L: En ce jour-là, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, je frapperai tout cheval d’égarement et son cavalier de folie ; mais sur la maison de Juda j’ouvrirai {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} yeux, et tout cheval des peuples, je le frapperai d’aveuglement.
fr.B: Ce jour-là, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, je frapperai tous les chevaux d’épouvante et leurs cavaliers de folie. Je garderai {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} yeux ouverts sur la maison de Juda, mais je frapperai d’aveuglement les chevaux des peuples.
fr.R: En ce temps-là, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, je ferai paniquer tous les chevaux et je rendrai fous leurs cavaliers. Je veillerai sur le peuple de Juda, mais je rendrai aveugles tous les chevaux des armées ennemies.

sw.L: Katika siku ile, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nitampiga kila farasi kwa mshangao na mpandaji wake kwa wazimu; lakini juu ya nyumba ya Yuda nitayafumbua macho {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, na kila farasi wa mataifa nitampiga kwa upofu.
sw.B: Siku hiyo, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nitawapiga farasi wote kwa hofu na wapandaji wao kwa wazimu. Nitaiangalia nyumba ya Yuda kwa macho {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} wazi, lakini farasi wa mataifa nitawapiga kwa upofu.
sw.R: Wakati huo, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nitawafanya farasi wote washtuke na wapandaji wao wawe wendawazimu. Nitawalinda watu wa Yuda, lakini nitawapofusha farasi wote wa majeshi ya adui.

vi.L: Trong ngày ấy, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đánh mọi con ngựa cho hoảng loạn và người cưỡi nó cho điên cuồng; nhưng trên nhà Giu-đa {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ mở mắt {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, và mọi con ngựa của các dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đánh cho mù lòa.
vi.B: Vào ngày ấy, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đánh mọi con ngựa cho kinh hoàng và người cưỡi chúng cho điên cuồng. Ta sẽ mở mắt trông chừng nhà Giu-đa, nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đánh các ngựa của các dân cho mù lòa.
vi.R: Vào lúc ấy, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm cho mọi con ngựa hoảng sợ và người cưỡi chúng hóa điên. Ta sẽ canh giữ dân Giu-đa, nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm cho mọi con ngựa của quân thù bị mù.

ko.L: 그날에 내가 모든 말을 쳐서 놀라게 하고, 그 탄 자를 쳐서 미치게 하겠다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다. 그러나 유다 집 위에는 내 눈을 뜨고, 민족들의 모든 말은 쳐서 눈멀게 하겠다.
ko.B: 그날에 내가 모든 말을 쳐서 겁에 질리게 하고, 그 탄 자들을 쳐서 미치게 하겠다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. 나는 유다 집을 눈여겨 지켜보겠지만, 민족들의 말은 모두 쳐서 눈멀게 하겠다.
ko.R: 그때에 내가 모든 말을 놀라 날뛰게 하고, 그 위에 탄 사람들을 미치게 하겠다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. 나는 유다 백성을 지켜 주겠지만, 원수 군대의 말들은 모두 눈이 멀게 하겠다.

decisions.choice: panic, madness, blindness: the curses of Deuteronomy 28:28 turned on the enemy
decisions.reason: Deuteronomy 28:28 warns that if Israel breaks the covenant, the LORD will strike them "with madness, with blindness and with confusion of heart". The same three words are used here, but now the LORD turns them on the nations who attack his people.

decisions.choice: I will open my eyes over the house of Judah: I will watch over them with care
decisions.reason: To have one's eyes open toward someone is to watch over them and care for them (1 Kings 8:29; Psalm 32:8). The enemy's horses are blinded, but the LORD's eyes are open over his people.

decisions.choice: In that day, declares the LORD (L); On that day, declares the LORD (B); At that time, says the LORD (R)
decisions.reason: The formulas follow the wording set in Isaiah. Readable says "watch over" for "open my eyes" (m2) and "enemy armies" for "the peoples". The LORD speaks of his own eyes, so "my" takes the deity_pronoun setting.

decisions.choice: "주의 선언이다" / "주가 말한다" after the first clause, as its own sentence
decisions.reason: The formula stands as its own sentence in Korean (terms note), so it follows the first clause instead of breaking it.

source.text: וְאָֽמְר֛וּ אַלֻּפֵ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה בְּלִבָּ֑ם אַמְצָ֥ה לִי֙ יֹשְׁבֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֔ם בַּיהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת אֱלֹהֵיהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And will say [the] clans of Judah in their heart, Strength to me [are the] inhabitants of Jerusalem in Yahweh of hosts their God.

en.L: And Judah's clans will say in their heart, "The inhabitants of Jerusalem [are] strength to me through {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts, their God."
en.B: Then the clans of Judah will say to themselves, "The people of Jerusalem are our strength, through {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies, their God."
en.R: Then the family groups of Judah will say to themselves, "The people of Jerusalem give us strength, because {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies is their God."

es.L: Y dirán los clanes de Judá en su corazón: «Fuerza para mí [son] los habitantes de Jerusalén por {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos, su Dios».
es.B: Entonces los clanes de Judá dirán para sí: «Los habitantes de Jerusalén son nuestra fuerza, gracias {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos, su Dios».
es.R: Entonces las familias de Judá dirán para sí: «La gente de Jerusalén nos da fuerza, porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos es su Dios».

fr.L: Et les clans de Juda diront en leur cœur : « Les habitants de Jérusalem [sont] une force pour moi par {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, leur Dieu. »
fr.B: Alors les clans de Juda se diront : « Les habitants de Jérusalem sont notre force, grâce {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} des armées, leur Dieu. »
fr.R: Alors les familles de Juda se diront : « Les gens de Jérusalem nous rendent forts, parce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées est leur Dieu. »

sw.L: Na koo za Yuda zitasema mioyoni mwao, "Wakaaji wa Yerusalemu [ni] nguvu kwangu kupitia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, Mungu wao."
sw.B: Kisha koo za Yuda zitasema mioyoni mwao, "Watu wa Yerusalemu ni nguvu yetu, kupitia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, Mungu wao."
sw.R: Kisha jamaa za Yuda zitajisemea, "Watu wa Yerusalemu wanatupa nguvu, kwa sababu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi ni Mungu wao."

vi.L: Các thị tộc Giu-đa sẽ nói trong lòng: "Dân cư Giê-ru-sa-lem [là] sức mạnh cho tôi nhờ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân, Đức Chúa Trời của họ."
vi.B: Bấy giờ các thị tộc Giu-đa sẽ tự nhủ: "Dân cư Giê-ru-sa-lem là sức mạnh của chúng ta, nhờ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân, Đức Chúa Trời của họ."
vi.R: Bấy giờ các gia tộc Giu-đa sẽ tự nhủ: "Dân Giê-ru-sa-lem làm cho chúng ta mạnh mẽ, vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân là Đức Chúa Trời của họ."

ko.L: 유다의 족장들이 마음속으로 말할 것이다. "예루살렘 주민들이 그들의 하나님 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}로 말미암아 나에게 힘[이 된다]."
ko.B: 그때 유다의 족장들이 속으로 말할 것이다. "예루살렘 주민들은 그들의 하나님 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 덕분에 우리의 힘이 된다."
ko.R: 그때 유다의 집안들이 속으로 말할 것이다. "하늘의 군대를 거느리신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 예루살렘 사람들의 하나님이시니, 그들이 우리에게 힘을 준다."

decisions.choice: the clans of Judah: Judah's clans and their leaders
decisions.reason: The word is the one used in 9:7, meaning a clan or the chief of a clan. Here it may mean Judah's leaders, who speak for their clans. Either way, the people of the countryside speak.

decisions.choice: the inhabitants of Jerusalem are strength to me through the LORD: Judah takes heart from Jerusalem and its God
alternatives: the inhabitants of Jerusalem have strength in the LORD of hosts their God
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is awkward, and its sense is debated. It is read here as Judah's clans saying that the people of Jerusalem give them strength, because the LORD of hosts is with the city. A small change in the letters gives "there is strength for the inhabitants of Jerusalem in the LORD of hosts their God". Both say that the strength comes from the LORD.

decisions.choice: say in their heart (L); say to themselves (B, R); our strength (B); give us strength (R); the LORD of Armies (B, R)
decisions.reason: "Say in their heart" is the Hebrew way of saying "think". The clans speak as one ("me"); Balanced and Readable say "us".

decisions.choice: "족장들" (L, B); "집안들" (R) for the clans of Judah
decisions.reason: The word means a clan or its chief (meaning decision m1); "족장들" keeps the chiefs who speak for their clans, and Readable says "family groups" plainly, as the English does.

source.text: בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֡וּא אָשִׂים֩ אֶת־אַלֻּפֵ֨י יְהוּדָ֜ה כְּֽכִיּ֧וֹר אֵ֣שׁ בְּעֵצִ֗ים וּכְלַפִּ֥יד אֵשׁ֙ בְּעָמִ֔יר וְאָ֨כְל֜וּ עַל־יָמִ֧ין וְעַל־שְׂמֹ֛אול אֶת־כָּל־הָעַמִּ֖ים סָבִ֑יב וְיָשְׁבָ֨ה יְרוּשָׁלִַ֥ם ע֛וֹד תַּחְתֶּ֖יהָ בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃פ

records.literal_gloss: On that day I will make [the] clans of Judah like a pot of fire among wood and like a torch of fire among sheaves, and they will devour on [the] right and on [the] left all the peoples around; and Jerusalem will dwell again in her place, in Jerusalem.

en.L: In that day I will make the clans of Judah like a pot of fire among wood and like a torch of fire among sheaves; and they will devour, on the right and on the left, all the peoples around; and Jerusalem will dwell again in her place, in Jerusalem.
en.B: On that day I will make Judah's clans like a firepot set in a pile of wood, like a flaming torch among sheaves of grain. They will consume all the surrounding peoples on the right and on the left, while Jerusalem stays secure in its place.
en.R: At that time I will make the family groups of Judah like a pot of burning coals in a pile of wood, or like a burning torch among bundles of grain. They will destroy all the nations around them, on every side. But Jerusalem will stay safe where it is.

es.L: En aquel día pondré a los clanes de Judá como brasero de fuego entre leña y como antorcha de fuego entre gavillas; y devorarán, a derecha y a izquierda, a todos los pueblos de alrededor; y Jerusalén habitará otra vez en su lugar, en Jerusalén.
es.B: Aquel día haré de los clanes de Judá un brasero encendido en medio de un montón de leña, una antorcha ardiente entre las gavillas. Consumirán a todos los pueblos de alrededor, a derecha y a izquierda, mientras Jerusalén permanece segura en su lugar.
es.R: En ese tiempo haré que las familias de Judá sean como una olla de brasas en un montón de leña, o como una antorcha encendida entre manojos de trigo. Destruirán a todas las naciones que las rodean, por todos lados. Pero Jerusalén seguirá segura donde está.

fr.L: En ce jour-là, je ferai des clans de Juda comme un pot de feu parmi du bois et comme une torche de feu parmi des gerbes ; et ils dévoreront, à droite et à gauche, tous les peuples d’alentour ; et Jérusalem habitera encore à sa place, à Jérusalem.
fr.B: Ce jour-là, je ferai des clans de Juda comme un brasier posé dans un tas de bois, comme une torche enflammée parmi des gerbes. Ils consumeront tous les peuples d’alentour, à droite et à gauche, tandis que Jérusalem restera en sûreté à sa place.
fr.R: En ce temps-là, je rendrai les familles de Juda pareilles à un pot de braises dans un tas de bois, ou à une torche allumée au milieu des bottes de blé. Elles détruiront toutes les nations autour d’elles, de tous les côtés. Mais Jérusalem restera en sécurité là où elle est.

sw.L: Katika siku ile nitazifanya koo za Yuda kama chungu cha moto katikati ya kuni, na kama mwenge wa moto katikati ya miganda; nazo zitateketeza, upande wa kuume na wa kushoto, mataifa yote yanayozunguka; na Yerusalemu utakaa tena mahali pake, katika Yerusalemu.
sw.B: Siku hiyo nitazifanya koo za Yuda kama chungu cha moto katika rundo la kuni, kama mwenge unaowaka katikati ya miganda ya nafaka. Zitayateketeza mataifa yote yanayozizunguka, kulia na kushoto, nao Yerusalemu utabaki salama mahali pake.
sw.R: Wakati huo nitazifanya jamaa za Yuda kama chungu cha makaa ya moto katika rundo la kuni, au kama mwenge unaowaka katikati ya mitita ya nafaka. Zitayaangamiza mataifa yote yanayozizunguka, kila upande. Lakini Yerusalemu utabaki salama mahali ulipo.

vi.L: Trong ngày ấy, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm cho các thị tộc Giu-đa như lò lửa giữa đống củi, như đuốc lửa giữa các bó lúa; họ sẽ thiêu nuốt bên phải và bên trái mọi dân chung quanh; và Giê-ru-sa-lem sẽ lại ở yên tại chỗ mình, tại Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.B: Vào ngày ấy, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm cho các thị tộc Giu-đa như lò than hồng đặt giữa đống củi, như ngọn đuốc cháy giữa các bó lúa. Họ sẽ thiêu hủy mọi dân chung quanh, bên phải lẫn bên trái, còn Giê-ru-sa-lem vẫn được an toàn tại chỗ mình.
vi.R: Vào lúc ấy, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm cho các gia tộc Giu-đa như một nồi than hồng giữa đống củi, hay như ngọn đuốc cháy giữa các bó lúa. Họ sẽ tiêu diệt mọi nước chung quanh, khắp mọi phía. Còn Giê-ru-sa-lem vẫn được an toàn tại chỗ của mình.

ko.L: 그날에 내가 유다의 족장들을 나무 가운데 있는 불 화로 같게 하고, 곡식단 가운데 있는 횃불 같게 하겠다. 그들이 오른쪽과 왼쪽으로 사방의 모든 민족을 삼킬 것이다. 그리고 예루살렘은 다시 제자리, 예루살렘에 자리 잡을 것이다.
ko.B: 그날에 내가 유다의 족장들을 장작더미 속의 불 화로처럼, 곡식단 사이의 타오르는 횃불처럼 만들겠다. 그들이 오른쪽과 왼쪽으로 주위의 모든 민족을 불살라 버릴 것이며, 예루살렘은 제자리에 굳게 서 있을 것이다.
ko.R: 그때에 내가 유다의 집안들을 장작더미 속에 놓인 숯불 그릇처럼, 곡식 단 사이에 놓인 타는 횃불처럼 만들겠다. 그들이 사방에 있는 모든 민족을 멸망시킬 것이다. 그러나 예루살렘은 그 자리에 안전하게 남을 것이다.

decisions.choice: a pot of fire among wood, a torch among sheaves: Judah will set the enemy ablaze
decisions.reason: A pot of live coals was used to carry fire; set down in a woodpile, it sets the whole pile alight. A torch among cut grain does the same (Judges 15:4-5). The small clans of Judah will consume the nations around them.

decisions.choice: on the right and on the left: on every side
decisions.reason: The phrase means in every direction (Isaiah 9:19; 54:3).

decisions.choice: Jerusalem will dwell again in her place, in Jerusalem: the city will stay where it is, unmoved
decisions.reason: The Hebrew names Jerusalem twice: the people of Jerusalem (the first time) will live on in their city (the second time). The city that the nations meant to carry off stays on its own site (14:10).

decisions.choice: firepot (B); a pot of burning coals (R); stays secure in its place (B); will stay safe where it is (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what the "pot of fire" was (m1), and say "in its place" once, without the second "in Jerusalem" (m3).

source.text: וְהוֹשִׁ֧יעַ יְהוָ֛ה אֶת־אָהֳלֵ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה בָּרִֽאשֹׁנָ֑ה לְמַ֨עַן לֹֽא־תִגְדַּ֜ל תִּפְאֶ֣רֶת בֵּית־דָּוִ֗יד וְתִפְאֶ֛רֶת יֹשֵׁ֥ב יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם עַל־יְהוּדָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And Yahweh will save the tents of Judah at first, so that will not be great [the] glory of [the] house of David and [the] glory of [the] inhabitant of Jerusalem over Judah.

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will save the tents of Judah at first, so that the splendor of the house of David and the splendor of the inhabitants of Jerusalem may not grow great over Judah.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will rescue the tents of Judah first, so that the honor of the house of David and of the people of Jerusalem will not be raised above Judah.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will rescue the people of the towns and villages of Judah first. Then the royal family of David and the people of Jerusalem will not think they are more important than the rest of Judah.

es.L: Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} salvará primero las tiendas de Judá, para que no se engrandezca la gloria de la casa de David ni la gloria de los habitantes de Jerusalén sobre Judá.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} rescatará primero las tiendas de Judá, para que el honor de la casa de David y de los habitantes de Jerusalén no se eleve por encima de Judá.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} rescatará primero a la gente de los pueblos y aldeas de Judá. Así la familia real de David y la gente de Jerusalén no pensarán que son más importantes que el resto de Judá.

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} sauvera d’abord les tentes de Juda, afin que la splendeur de la maison de David et la splendeur des habitants de Jérusalem ne s’élèvent pas au-dessus de Juda.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} délivrera d’abord les tentes de Juda, afin que l’honneur de la maison de David et des habitants de Jérusalem ne soit pas élevé au-dessus de Juda.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} délivrera d’abord les gens des villes et des villages de Juda. Ainsi, la famille royale de David et les habitants de Jérusalem ne se croiront pas plus importants que le reste de Juda.

sw.L: Na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ataziokoa hema za Yuda kwanza, ili fahari ya nyumba ya Daudi na fahari ya wakaaji wa Yerusalemu isiwe kubwa juu ya Yuda.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ataziokoa hema za Yuda kwanza, ili heshima ya nyumba ya Daudi na ya watu wa Yerusalemu isiinuliwe juu ya Yuda.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atawaokoa kwanza watu wa miji na vijiji vya Yuda. Kisha jamaa ya kifalme ya Daudi na watu wa Yerusalemu hawatajiona kuwa bora kuliko watu wengine wa Yuda.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ giải cứu các lều trại của Giu-đa trước, để vinh quang của nhà Đa-vít và vinh quang của dân cư Giê-ru-sa-lem không được tôn cao hơn Giu-đa.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ giải cứu các lều trại của Giu-đa trước, để vinh dự của nhà Đa-vít và của dân cư Giê-ru-sa-lem không được nâng cao hơn Giu-đa.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ giải cứu dân chúng ở các thành và làng mạc của Giu-đa trước. Như vậy hoàng tộc Đa-vít và dân Giê-ru-sa-lem sẽ không nghĩ rằng mình quan trọng hơn những người khác trong Giu-đa.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 유다의 장막들을 먼저 구원할 것이다. 다윗 집의 영광과 예루살렘 주민의 영광이 유다보다 커지지 않게 하려는 것이다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 유다의 장막들을 먼저 구하여, 다윗 집과 예루살렘 주민들의 영광이 유다 위로 높아지지 않게 할 것이다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 유다의 성읍과 마을에 사는 사람들을 먼저 구할 것이다. 그러면 다윗의 왕족과 예루살렘 사람들이 자기들이 유다의 다른 사람들보다 더 중요하다고 생각하지 않을 것이다.

decisions.choice: the tents of Judah: the people of the countryside
decisions.reason: "Tents" is an old word for homes (1 Kings 8:66; Jeremiah 30:18). Here it means the open towns and villages of Judah, which had no walls to protect them, in contrast to the walled city of Jerusalem.

decisions.choice: so that the glory of the house of David ... may not be made great over Judah: no pride of the capital over the rest
decisions.reason: The LORD saves the weakest first, so that the royal family and the capital cannot boast over the countryside. The victory is the LORD's, shared by all his people (1 Corinthians 1:27-29 gives the same reason for God's choices).

decisions.choice: the people of the towns and villages of Judah; the royal family of David; think they are more important (R)
decisions.reason: Readable explains "the tents of Judah" (m1) and what "glory over Judah" means (m2).

decisions.choice: "주가 ... 구원할 것이다", with no -시-
decisions.reason: The LORD is the speaker of verses 2-10 and names himself here in the third person; God takes no honorific in his own mouth.

source.text: בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא יָגֵ֤ן יְהוָה֙ בְּעַד֙ יוֹשֵׁ֣ב יְרוּשָׁלִַ֔ם וְהָיָ֞ה הַנִּכְשָׁ֥ל בָּהֶ֛ם בַּיּ֥וֹם הַה֖וּא כְּדָוִ֑יד וּבֵ֤ית דָּוִיד֙ כֵּֽאלֹהִ֔ים כְּמַלְאַ֥ךְ יְהוָ֖ה לִפְנֵיהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: On that day Yahweh will defend the inhabitant of Jerusalem, and will be the one stumbling among them on that day like David, and the house of David like God, like [the] angel of Yahweh before them.

en.L: In that day {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will defend the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and the one who stumbles among them in that day will be like David; and the house of David like God, like the angel of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} before them.
en.B: On that day {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will shield the people of Jerusalem. On that day even the feeblest of them will be like David, and David's house like God, like the angel of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} at their head.
en.R: At that time {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will protect the people of Jerusalem. Even the weakest of them will be as strong as King David. David's family will be like God, like the angel of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} who leads them.

es.L: En aquel día {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} defenderá a los habitantes de Jerusalén, y el que tropiece entre ellos en aquel día será como David; y la casa de David como Dios, como el ángel {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} delante de ellos.
es.B: Aquel día {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} será el escudo de los habitantes de Jerusalén. Aquel día aun el más débil de ellos será como David, y la casa de David como Dios, como el ángel {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} al frente de ellos.
es.R: En ese tiempo {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} protegerá a la gente de Jerusalén. Hasta el más débil de ellos será tan fuerte como el rey David. La familia de David será como Dios, como el ángel {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} que los guía.

fr.L: En ce jour-là, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} protégera les habitants de Jérusalem, et celui qui chancelle parmi eux en ce jour-là sera comme David ; et la maison de David [sera] comme Dieu, comme l’ange {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} devant eux.
fr.B: Ce jour-là, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} sera un bouclier pour les habitants de Jérusalem. Ce jour-là, le plus faible d’entre eux sera comme David, et la maison de David comme Dieu, comme l’ange {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} à leur tête.
fr.R: En ce temps-là, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} protégera les habitants de Jérusalem. Même le plus faible d’entre eux sera aussi fort que le roi David. La famille de David sera comme Dieu, comme l’ange {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} qui les conduit.

sw.L: Katika siku ile {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atawalinda wakaaji wa Yerusalemu, na yeye ajikwaaye miongoni mwao katika siku ile atakuwa kama Daudi; na nyumba ya Daudi [itakuwa] kama Mungu, kama malaika wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} mbele yao.
sw.B: Siku hiyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakuwa ngao ya watu wa Yerusalemu. Siku hiyo hata aliye dhaifu kabisa miongoni mwao atakuwa kama Daudi, na nyumba ya Daudi kama Mungu, kama malaika wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anayewatangulia.
sw.R: Wakati huo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atawalinda watu wa Yerusalemu. Hata aliye dhaifu kuliko wote miongoni mwao atakuwa na nguvu kama mfalme Daudi. Jamaa ya Daudi itakuwa kama Mungu, kama malaika wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anayewaongoza.

vi.L: Trong ngày ấy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ che chở dân cư Giê-ru-sa-lem, và kẻ vấp ngã trong vòng họ trong ngày ấy sẽ như Đa-vít; và nhà Đa-vít [sẽ] như Đức Chúa Trời, như thiên sứ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đi trước họ.
vi.B: Vào ngày ấy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ làm khiên che chở dân Giê-ru-sa-lem. Vào ngày ấy, ngay cả người yếu nhất trong họ cũng sẽ như Đa-vít, và nhà Đa-vít sẽ như Đức Chúa Trời, như thiên sứ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đi đầu họ.
vi.R: Vào lúc ấy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ bảo vệ dân Giê-ru-sa-lem. Ngay cả người yếu nhất trong họ cũng sẽ mạnh mẽ như vua Đa-vít. Dòng họ Đa-vít sẽ như Đức Chúa Trời, như thiên sứ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} dẫn dắt họ.

ko.L: 그날에 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 예루살렘 주민들을 방패로 막아 줄 것이다. 그날에 그들 가운데 비틀거리는 자도 다윗 같을 것이며, 다윗 집은 하나님 같고, 그들 앞에 있는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 천사 같을 것이다.
ko.B: 그날에 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 예루살렘 주민들을 방패처럼 지켜 줄 것이다. 그날에는 그들 가운데 가장 약한 자도 다윗 같고, 다윗 집은 하나님 같고, 그들을 앞장서 이끄는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 천사 같을 것이다.
ko.R: 그때에 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 예루살렘 사람들을 지켜 줄 것이다. 그들 가운데 가장 약한 사람도 다윗 왕처럼 강해질 것이다. 다윗의 집안은 하나님 같고, 그들을 이끄는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 천사 같을 것이다.

decisions.choice: the one who stumbles will be like David: the weakest will be as strong as the warrior king
decisions.reason: "The one who stumbles" is the weak and feeble (1 Samuel 2:4). David was remembered as the great warrior who killed Goliath and won Israel's wars. On that day even the weakest will fight like him.

decisions.choice: the house of David will be like God, like the angel of the LORD: like a divine leader going ahead of the people
decisions.reason: The word for God can also mean a divine or heavenly being, and the next words limit it: "like the angel of the LORD before them". The angel of the LORD went before Israel out of Egypt (Exodus 14:19; 23:20; 32:34). The royal house will lead the people with God's own strength. People said of David himself that he was "like the angel of God" in wisdom (2 Samuel 14:17, 20; 19:28).

decisions.choice: defend: shield
decisions.reason: The verb is the one used in 9:15, from the word for a shield.

decisions.choice: In that day ... in that day (L); On that day ... On that day (B); At that time (R, once)
decisions.reason: The formula follows the wording set in Isaiah. Readable says it once, since the second only repeats the first, and says "as strong as King David" to make the comparison clear (m1).

source.text: וְהָיָ֖ה בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֑וּא אֲבַקֵּ֗שׁ לְהַשְׁמִיד֙ אֶת־כָּל־הַגּוֹיִ֔ם הַבָּאִ֖ים עַל־יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And it will be on that day [that] I will seek to destroy all the nations that come against Jerusalem.

en.L: And it will be in that day [that] I will seek to wipe out all the nations that are coming against Jerusalem.
en.B: On that day I will set about destroying every nation that comes against Jerusalem.
en.R: At that time I will make sure that all the nations that attack Jerusalem are destroyed.

es.L: Y sucederá en aquel día [que] buscaré destruir a todas las naciones que vienen contra Jerusalén.
es.B: Aquel día me dispondré a destruir a toda nación que venga contra Jerusalén.
es.R: En ese tiempo me aseguraré de que sean destruidas todas las naciones que ataquen Jerusalén.

fr.L: Et il arrivera en ce jour-là [que] je chercherai à anéantir toutes les nations qui viennent contre Jérusalem.
fr.B: Ce jour-là, je m’appliquerai à détruire toutes les nations qui viendront contre Jérusalem.
fr.R: En ce temps-là, je ferai en sorte que toutes les nations qui attaquent Jérusalem soient détruites.

sw.L: Na itakuwa katika siku ile, nitatafuta kuyaangamiza mataifa yote yanayokuja juu ya Yerusalemu.
sw.B: Siku hiyo nitaazimia kuyaangamiza mataifa yote yanayokuja kuushambulia Yerusalemu.
sw.R: Wakati huo nitahakikisha kwamba mataifa yote yanayoushambulia Yerusalemu yanaangamizwa.

vi.L: Sẽ xảy ra trong ngày ấy, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ tìm cách hủy diệt mọi nước đến tấn công Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.B: Vào ngày ấy, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ ra tay hủy diệt mọi nước kéo đến đánh Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.R: Vào lúc ấy, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} chắc chắn sẽ tiêu diệt mọi nước tấn công Giê-ru-sa-lem.

ko.L: 그날에 이렇게 될 것이다. 내가 예루살렘을 치러 오는 모든 나라를 멸하려고 찾을 것이다.
ko.B: 그날에 내가 예루살렘을 치러 오는 모든 나라를 멸하기로 작정할 것이다.
ko.R: 그때에 나는 예루살렘을 공격하는 모든 나라를 반드시 멸망시키겠다.

decisions.choice: I will seek to destroy: I will set myself to destroy
decisions.reason: When the LORD "seeks" to do something, it is not an attempt that might fail but a firm purpose. The nations that come against Jerusalem will be destroyed.

decisions.choice: set about (B); make sure that (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable avoid "seek to", which in English suggests an attempt that might fail (m1).

source.text: וְשָׁפַכְתִּי֩ עַל־בֵּ֨ית דָּוִ֜יד וְעַ֣ל׀יוֹשֵׁ֣ב יְרוּשָׁלִַ֗ם ר֤וּחַ חֵן֙ וְתַ֣חֲנוּנִ֔ים וְהִבִּ֥יטוּ אֵלַ֖י אֵ֣ת אֲשֶׁר־דָּקָ֑רוּ וְסָפְד֣וּ עָלָ֗יו כְּמִסְפֵּד֙ עַל־הַיָּחִ֔יד וְהָמֵ֥ר עָלָ֖יו כְּהָמֵ֥ר עַֽל־הַבְּכֽוֹר׃

records.literal_gloss: And I will pour out on [the] house of David and on [the] inhabitant of Jerusalem a spirit of grace and supplications, and they will look to me, [the one] whom they have pierced; and they will mourn over him like [the] mourning over the only [child], and [there will be] bitterness over him like [the] bitterness over the firstborn.

en.L: And I will pour out upon the house of David and on the inhabitants of Jerusalem a spirit of grace and of pleas for mercy, and they will look on {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, the one they pierced; and they will mourn for him as one mourns for an only [son], and grieve bitterly for him as one grieves bitterly for a firstborn.
en.B: On the house of David and on the people of Jerusalem I will pour out a spirit of grace and of prayer for mercy. They will look on {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, the one they pierced, and they will mourn for him as one mourns for an only son, and weep bitterly over him as for a firstborn son.
en.R: I will pour out on the family of David and the people of Jerusalem a spirit of kindness and of praying for mercy. They will look on {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, the one they pierced. They will mourn for him as parents mourn for their only son. They will cry bitterly over him as people cry over the death of their oldest son.

es.L: Y derramaré sobre la casa de David y sobre los habitantes de Jerusalén un espíritu de gracia y de súplicas, y {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} mirarán a {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, a quien traspasaron; y harán duelo por él como se hace duelo por un [hijo] único, y llorarán amargamente por él como se llora amargamente por un primogénito.
es.B: Sobre la casa de David y sobre los habitantes de Jerusalén derramaré un espíritu de gracia y de súplica. Me mirarán a {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, al que traspasaron, y harán duelo por él como se hace duelo por un hijo único, y llorarán amargamente por él como por un primogénito.
es.R: Derramaré sobre la familia de David y sobre la gente de Jerusalén un espíritu de bondad y de oración para pedir misericordia. Me mirarán a {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, al que atravesaron. Harán duelo por él como los padres hacen duelo por su único hijo. Llorarán amargamente por él como se llora la muerte del hijo mayor.

fr.L: Et je répandrai sur la maison de David et sur les habitants de Jérusalem un esprit de grâce et de supplications, et ils regarderont vers {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, celui qu’ils ont transpercé ; et ils se lamenteront sur lui comme on se lamente sur un [fils] unique, et ils pleureront amèrement sur lui comme on pleure amèrement sur un premier-né.
fr.B: Sur la maison de David et sur les habitants de Jérusalem, je répandrai un esprit de grâce et de supplication. Ils regarderont vers {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, celui qu’ils ont transpercé, et ils se lamenteront sur lui comme on se lamente sur un fils unique, et ils pleureront amèrement sur lui comme sur un fils premier-né.
fr.R: Je répandrai sur la famille de David et sur les habitants de Jérusalem un esprit de bonté et de prière pour demander pitié. Ils regarderont vers {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, celui qu’ils ont transpercé. Ils pleureront sur lui comme des parents pleurent leur fils unique. Ils pleureront amèrement sur lui comme on pleure la mort de son fils aîné.

sw.L: Nami nitamwaga juu ya nyumba ya Daudi na juu ya wakaaji wa Yerusalemu roho ya neema na ya kusihi, nao watanitazama {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}}, yule ambaye walimtoboa; nao watamwombolezea kama mtu amwombolezeavyo [mwana] wa pekee, na kumlilia kwa uchungu kama mtu amliliavyo kwa uchungu mzaliwa wa kwanza.
sw.B: Juu ya nyumba ya Daudi na juu ya watu wa Yerusalemu nitamwaga roho ya neema na ya kuomba rehema. Watanitazama {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}}, yule waliyemtoboa, nao watamwombolezea kama mtu amwombolezeavyo mwana wa pekee, na kumlilia kwa uchungu kama kwa mzaliwa wa kwanza.
sw.R: Nitamwaga juu ya jamaa ya Daudi na watu wa Yerusalemu roho ya wema na ya kuomba rehema. Watanitazama {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}}, yule waliyemchoma. Watamwombolezea kama wazazi wanavyomwombolezea mwana wao wa pekee. Watamlilia kwa uchungu kama watu wanavyolia kwa kifo cha mwana wao wa kwanza.

vi.L: Ta sẽ đổ trên nhà Đa-vít và trên dân cư Giê-ru-sa-lem một thần linh của ân điển và của lời nài xin, và họ sẽ nhìn lên {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, là Đấng họ đã đâm; họ sẽ khóc thương người như khóc thương con [trai] một, và khóc lóc đắng cay vì người như khóc lóc đắng cay vì con trưởng nam.
vi.B: Ta sẽ đổ trên nhà Đa-vít và trên dân cư Giê-ru-sa-lem một thần linh của ân điển và của lời khẩn nguyện. Họ sẽ nhìn lên {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, là Đấng họ đã đâm, và họ sẽ khóc thương người như khóc thương con trai một, và khóc lóc đắng cay vì người như khóc con trưởng nam.
vi.R: Ta sẽ đổ trên dòng họ Đa-vít và dân Giê-ru-sa-lem một tâm linh nhân từ và biết cầu xin lòng thương xót. Họ sẽ nhìn lên {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, là Đấng họ đã đâm. Họ sẽ khóc thương người như cha mẹ khóc thương đứa con trai duy nhất. Họ sẽ khóc lóc đắng cay vì người như người ta khóc khi đứa con trai đầu lòng qua đời.

ko.L: 내가 다윗 집과 예루살렘 주민들 위에 은총과 간구의 영을 부어 줄 것이다. 그러면 그들이 자기들이 찌른 나를 바라볼 것이다. 그들이 하나뿐인 [아들]을 위하여 애곡하듯이 그를 위하여 애곡하고, 맏아들을 위하여 슬피 울듯이 그를 위하여 슬피 울 것이다.
ko.B: 내가 다윗 집과 예루살렘 주민들에게 은총과 간구의 영을 부어 주겠다. 그들이 자기들이 찌른 나를 바라볼 것이다. 그들은 외아들을 잃고 애곡하듯이 그를 위하여 애곡하고, 맏아들을 잃고 슬피 울듯이 그를 위하여 슬피 울 것이다.
ko.R: 내가 다윗 집안과 예루살렘 사람들에게 은혜를 베풀고 자비를 구하게 하는 영을 부어 주겠다. 그들이 자기들이 찌른 나를 바라볼 것이다. 부모가 외아들을 잃고 슬퍼하듯이 그들이 그를 위해 슬퍼할 것이다. 맏아들이 죽었을 때처럼 그를 위해 슬피 울 것이다.

decisions.choice: a spirit of grace and of pleas for mercy: God's gift that moves the people to seek his mercy
decisions.reason: To "pour out" a spirit is God's own gift of a new heart and will (Joel 3:1; Ezekiel 39:29). "Grace" is God's favor, and the second word means pleading for mercy. The spirit God gives turns the people to him in sorrow and prayer.

decisions.choice: they will look on me: the Hebrew text, against the reading "on him"
alternatives: they will look on him, the one they pierced
decisions.reason: The standard Hebrew text, with most manuscripts, has "on me", and the Septuagint agrees. A number of medieval Hebrew manuscripts read "on him", which makes the sentence run more smoothly into "they will mourn for him". The harder reading "on me" is very likely the original, since scribes would change it to "on him" and not the other way round. It is kept here. John 19:37 quotes the verse as "they will look on the one they pierced", without either pronoun.

decisions.choice: me, the one they pierced ... him: who is pierced
alternatives: they will look to me concerning the one they pierced (a person distinct from God)
decisions.reason: The LORD speaks, and says "they will look on me"; the next words, "the one they pierced", may describe the LORD himself, and the verse then goes on to speak of "him". Three main readings are given. First, the LORD so binds himself to the one pierced that to pierce him was to strike at the LORD. Second, the words may mean "they will look to me concerning the one they pierced", so that the pierced one is a person distinct from God: some Jewish readers have seen a leader of the people killed in battle, and the Talmud speaks of a messiah son of Joseph who will be slain. Third, the New Testament reads the verse of Jesus, pierced on the cross (m6). The Hebrew allows the first two; the text does not say who the pierced one is.

decisions.choice: pierced: thrust through, killed
decisions.reason: The verb means to run someone through with a sword or spear, usually to death (Numbers 25:8; 1 Samuel 31:4). In 13:3 it is used of parents running through a son who prophesies falsely. The Septuagint read a similar verb meaning "mocked" or "danced in triumph".

decisions.choice: mourn as for an only son, as for a firstborn: the deepest grief
decisions.reason: The loss of an only son, or of the firstborn, was the bitterest grief there was, because it ended a family's future (Amos 8:10; Jeremiah 6:26). The mourning is for the one pierced, and it goes with repentance: the people grieve for what they have done.

decisions.choice: quoted in John 19:37, and taken up in Revelation 1:7
decisions.reason: John 19:37 quotes this verse when a soldier pierces the side of Jesus on the cross: "They will look on the one they pierced". Revelation 1:7 joins it to Daniel 7:13 of Jesus' coming: every eye will see him, "even those who pierced him", and all the tribes of the earth will mourn (compare verses 12-14 here).

decisions.choice: on me (deity_pronoun setting); him (no setting)
decisions.reason: "Me" is the LORD speaking of himself, so it takes the deity_pronoun setting, as every pronoun the LORD uses of himself does. "Him", the one mourned, takes none. The verse moves to the third person, and whether "him" is the LORD, a human figure, or Jesus as the New Testament reads it, is the question the decisions leave open (m3). As with the king of 9:9, a capital letter would settle it.

decisions.choice: they will look on me, the one they pierced (every level); as for an only son
decisions.reason: The words "they will look on me, the one they pierced" are the same at every level, as set for this verse, so that the reader can follow the quotation in John 19:37. The comparison with mourning for an only son follows Amos 8:10.

decisions.choice: "{{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} mirarán a {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, a quien traspasaron" (L); "al que traspasaron" (B); "al que atravesaron" (R)
decisions.reason: The words of the published John 19:37 ("traspasaron" L, B; "atravesaron" R) and Revelation 1:7, kept so the quotation can be seen (meaning decision m6); the Hebrew's "me" is kept (m2) and takes the deity_pronoun setting, while "él", the one mourned, takes none (m3).

decisions.reason: The words of the published John 19:37 ("ils regarderont vers celui qu'ils ont transpercé"), with the Hebrew's "me" kept (meaning decisions m2, m6). "Lui", the one mourned, takes no span (m3).

decisions.choice: the mourning of Hadad-rimmon in the plain of Megiddo: probably the mourning for King Josiah
alternatives: the ritual mourning for the god Hadad-rimmon
decisions.reason: Hadad-rimmon is named only here. It is most often taken as a place near Megiddo, and the mourning as the great lament for King Josiah, who was killed in battle with Pharaoh Neco in the plain of Megiddo in 609 BC (2 Kings 23:29; 2 Chronicles 35:22-25). His death was mourned for generations. Others take Hadad-rimmon as the name of a storm god, Hadad, also called Rimmon (2 Kings 5:18), whose worshipers mourned him each year as dead, as women wept for Tammuz (Ezekiel 8:14). Either way, the comparison is with a mourning remembered as the greatest the people knew.

decisions.choice: the mourning at Hadad-rimmon (B, R); valley of Megiddo (R)

decisions.choice: clan by clan, each by itself, and their wives by themselves: the whole people in mourning, family by family
decisions.reason: The mourning is not a crowd's but each family's, and the men and the women mourn apart, as was the custom at times of solemn mourning and prayer. The phrase "by itself" is repeated eleven times in verses 12-14, so that no family is left out.

decisions.choice: the house of David, the house of Nathan: the royal line and a branch of it
decisions.reason: Nathan is most likely David's son (2 Samuel 5:14), whose line is traced in Luke 3:31; it may instead be Nathan the prophet. With Levi and Shimei (verse 13), the list names two royal families and two priestly ones: the leaders mourn first.

decisions.choice: by itself (L); on its own (B); by itself, by themselves (R); comma at the end (L, B)
decisions.reason: Every level repeats the phrase as the Hebrew does. The sentence runs on to the end of verse 14, so Literal and Balanced end with a semicolon and go on; Readable makes each family a sentence. "Wives" may also be "women".

alternatives: one sentence running to the end of verse 14
decisions.reason: Korean puts its verb last, so a list running over three verses would leave verses 12 and 13 without one; each verse ends with its own "애곡할 것이다".
